SELECT toString(toTimeZone(timestamp,'Asia/Shanghai')) AS t,
       toString(person_id) AS pid,
       coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.readerId),''),'(无)') AS rid,
       coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.platform),''),'(无)') AS plat,
       toString(properties.rank) AS rank,
       toString(properties.matchPercentage) AS pct,
       coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.$pathname),''),'') AS path
FROM events WHERE coalesce(properties.$host,'') = 'easternalignment.com'
  AND coalesce(properties.$geoip_country_code,'') != 'CN'
  AND coalesce(properties.$session_entry_referring_domain,'') NOT IN ('localhost:4321','127.0.0.1:8188','127.0.0.1:8765','localhost:8765','127.0.0.1:8931')
  AND (person_id IS NULL OR toString(person_id) NOT IN ('8435b8d5-16b6-5f4b-9b71-f5d4d196ad00','83b89204-633d-56fa-9e65-202e62d839ff','259d7d34-120f-50a6-a260-3e7fa192ae79','8b444548-d415-5d49-88b2-f717feaba288','b7575d9c-8453-5600-874a-47188ad98ec8','01a0b5bc-770d-7c62-b34d-5416ccb6f386')) AND event='reader_clicked' AND timestamp >= toDateTime(1790092800)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
